Summary. Each manufacturer, except GM, stated that a weight reduction of 50 pounds by 1979 is not practical.

AMC further stated that a weight increase may occur by 1979 due to changes in future design criteria. GM agreed that a 50-pound weight reduction, fleetwide, would shift 10 percent of the vehicles in one inertia weight class to the next lower. GM did not, however, confirm that they planned a 50-pound weight reduction by 1979.
Analysis. Since the EIS specifically assumes that only GM will be required to achieve a 50-pound fleet weight reduction to help achieve the NPA AFES, and does not apply the 50-pound weight reduction to the AMC, Chrysler, Ford and International Harvester fleets no changes will be made to the EIS. Further analysis of weight reduction comments is included in the preamble to the final rule.
